svg.title: Vale and Ila set equal limits on favour and automated denial.
svg.desc: Vale keeps the contractor override file open while Ila keeps the automatic denial cases open. Riju and Cecil stand between the two evidence sets as both constraints become public requirements.
svg.text: Page 55, panel 5 · Opposed wide two-shot across the public evidence
